note: normalized SIGNATURE patterns + a reason each; never captured log content. status: expected | benign | known-defect | unsettled. max_per_boot is the rise ceiling (rise = > max(ceiling*rise_factor, ceiling+rise_min_delta)). Newly-seen signatures whose Jev verdict was below the 0.5 floor are deliberately NOT recorded here: they must keep surfacing as new until a human judges them, or the refresh would turn unjudged lines into silent ones.

agent_unrequested_deaths.why: ADR-supervision 1: an unrequested death of ours is a major error

agent_deaths_at_shutdown.why: a shutdown must stop the agent through the watchdog, never kill it

agent_relaunches_at_shutdown.why: something of ours died and was silently put back: a relaunch into an ending session is the 2026-10-07 defect, and the silence is the reporting hole, not a lower severity

error_lines_undeclared.why: owner 2026-10-07: a clean error log is THE gate condition - any error line our own code wrote, and that this run did not declare it caused, is a defect to fix at its cause (never to hide)

declared_errors_unmatched.why: a declared error that never appeared: the stimulus the run claims to have applied did not happen, so the run proved less than it says

agent_instances_per_shutdown.why: one agent per shutdown; three = three vchan setups with dom0

notifications_lost.why: our own code raised a user-facing message and could NOT deliver it - the user was told nothing. The counterpart to dom0_loud_failures, which counts what the user DID see; the owner's rule is 'no doubles, nothing lost' and this is the second half of it

dom0_loud_failures.why: our own code told dom0 to show the USER that something of ours failed - a line on the dom0 notification path that its own writer declared W or E. A failure the user can SEE is P1 on this project; the severity comes from the writer and the path comes from our own protocol tokens, so neither is guessed

clock_boot_correction_s.why: the guest's clock had to be moved this far mid-boot: its RTC does not hold what the guest thinks it holds (qube `timezone` feature vs the guest's own zone). Measured 2026-10-14 at 10800 s - three hours - on every cell, while this analyser SILENTLY SHIFTED 2249 lines to compensate and raised nothing. Every timestamp judgement on such a guest is unsound, and the owner sees a guest whose clock is wrong

agent_instances_per_boot.why: the agent is started once per boot; a second instance is a death or a restart

agent_ends_unrecorded.why: an agent log that stops with no requested stop and no death record

vchan_setups_per_shutdown.why: no new vchan announcement while the guest is going down

vchan_announce_without_connect.why: an announced vchan that dom0 never connected to AND that the agent never withdrew - an announcement the agent takes back on its way out (it logs so) is correct behaviour, not a dangling vchan

vchan_reconnects.why: a second announcement in one instance means the session LOST its daemon - the breach is the loss, not the re-announce: reconnecting is best effort and PERMITTED (owner 2026-10-10), and no suite may require it

handshake_refusals.why: QGAHANDSHAKE: messages refused before the version exchange

broker_deaths.why: QGABROKERDIED outside a fault-injection context - owner policy 2026-10-07: a spontaneous de-slice broker death is P1 (findings/issues.md P1 'A SPONTANEOUS DE-SLICE BROKER DEATH OR HANG IS P1')

broker_hangs.why: QGABROKERHUNG outside a fault-injection context (same policy)

fi_detection_missing.why: an M8 injection record whose detection is absent (QGABROKERHUNG within 2 s of the next registration, then reap + relaunch): the test failing silently is the other half of M8

fi_context_unproven.why: the run was declared fault-injection, but no log carries QGAFAULT-INIT and no injection record is in the capture: the test build / injection was not running (the rz24 lesson); nothing is excused

closed_defect_recurrence.why: a signature whose issue the baseline records as CLOSED recurred: a regression

helper_deaths.why: QGANOTIFBRIDGEEXIT / ETWPROXYSUP exited: the notification bridge or etwproxy died (the broker has its own metric)

helper_relaunches.why: a helper launched more than once in one agent instance (broker relaunches after an injected hang excluded)

requested_stop_nonzero_exit.why: a requested stop must exit 0 (the 0xb7 case)

errors_during_requested_stop.why: no ERROR line between the watchdog's 'asked to exit' and 'is gone'

stale_error_lines.why: 'failed with error 0x0: The operation completed successfully' is a stale error code

watchdog_fast_death_backoffs.why: the agent died within 10 s of launch, or a launch failed

service_failures.why: System 7023/7024/7031/7034/7043 for one of our services

wer_crashes.why: Application 1000/1001/1026 for one of our executables

death_events.why: Application 4001-4004 under 'Qubes Windows Tools': a supervisor recorded a death

death_record_mismatch.why: a watchdog death line without its 4001 record, or a 4001 without the line (ADR-supervision 2)

unexpected_shutdowns.why: System 6008 / Kernel-Power 41: the previous shutdown was not clean

task_failures.why: a TaskScheduler record for one of our tasks that is a FAILURE: a 203 launch failure the scheduler did not refuse for shutdown, or a 201 whose return code is non-zero and not a shutdown code. A 201 with return code 0 is a task doing its job and is not counted - counting it made this threshold unreachable on every healthy boot

fallbacks_fired.why: project rule: a fallback firing is an anomaly, logged loudly and diagnosed
